translated_text: Right belief, right knowledge, and right conduct (together) constitute the path to liberation.
Belief in the substances, etc., ascertained as they are, is right belief.
That (belief) arises either spontaneously or from learning.
The soul, the non-soul, influx, bondage, stoppage, gradual shedding, and liberation constitute the realities.
These (are cognized) by name, representation, substance, and state.
